findings.description: Some captions in the previously existing first 35 frames fall over cream hair and rely mainly on narrow dark contours. Do not describe all 217 captions as clear.

Isolated pale short marks are visible immediately beside the short Japanese line. Static page inspection alone does not establish whether they are protected original effects or old text/subject residue; attribution is left unresolved.
The collar and medallion treatment changes noticeably between the temple-pointing pose and spread-arms pose. The original collar remains simpler; the Klee ornament drift remains unaccepted.

positive_observations: The f1172 lower raised cuff is visibly filled with cream fabric in the encoded output; no sky-colored hole was seen in the actual native crop.
The inspected f1172 and f1203 glove-to-cuff connections remain connected in the encoded output.
Both f1224 spread gloves show five visible digit projections in the native crops, with the original left/right gesture retained.
Closeup captions [1162,1225) remain readable in the reviewed native pages. This does not certify exact every-stroke equality to the source.

noise_diagnostics.meaning: These measurements describe lossy encoding differences from the frozen raw checkpoint. No pixel-equality ownership or glyph-completeness acceptance is inferred.
